desc: Base life (GARDEN.md section 4, scripts/home/base_life.gd): with farm_build.json base_mode on, every farm Boki runs one state machine (Roam, Eat, Nap, Play, PlayWith, Watch, React, Mentor, Chore) and keeps rec['bonds'] = {uid: -1..1}. Times are seconds, distances metres (tiles), bond changes are per event unless they say per second.
think_doc: s between a roaming Boki's choices (random in the range).
max_doc: s a Boki stays in each state before it moves on (Play is HomeToys' time at a toy, toys.json play_secs; eat also caps the walk for a snack, BaseFeed); a Boki that roamed this long picks something to do. Nap has no cap: night naps last till morning.
chore_chance_doc: chance a roaming Boki whose knack has a chore to do right now (scripts/home/base_chore.gd) does it.
chore_mind_doc: s an Ember Boki sits by the egg before the egg's hatch time halves.
nap_doc: s of a day nap (energy low or bored); at night a non-nocturnal Boki naps till dawn.
spot_walk_doc: s a Boki walks to a nap spot (garden_zones.json nap) before it naps where it is.
spot_reach_doc: m: the farthest nap spot a Boki about to nap walks to; past it, or with every spot taken, it naps where it stands.
tired_at_doc: energy need below which a Boki naps by day.
greet_at_doc: the least liking (bond, plus the parent weight) at which a roaming Boki waves hello to one close by: Boki that get on greet before they are friends (friend_at).
greet_chance_doc: chance a roaming Boki that chooses waves hello when a Boki it likes (greet_at) is close by (a heart).
doze_doc: chance, each time a roaming Boki chooses by day, that it lies down for a nap although it is not tired; doze_pile is added while a Boki it does not dislike (pile_at) naps within pile_reach m, so the nap becomes a pile.
doze_rest_doc: s after a Boki wakes before it may doze again, so one nap does not set off a chain of piles.
pile_reach_doc: m: how far away a Boki about to nap looks for a napping one to lie beside (the walk is PILE_WALK s at most).
pile_at_doc: the least liking (bond, plus the parent weight) for a dozing Boki (one that is not tired) to lie beside a napping one, and for napping side by side to grow a bond: Boki that have hardly met huddle too, which is how they become friends; rivals do not make up asleep.
near_doc: m within which another Boki counts as close: a play mate, a rival to stare at, a pile to join.
pile_doc: how close two napping friends may lie, as a share of their normal personal space.
parent_weight_doc: added to a young (not yet Grown) Boki's liking for its own parent when it picks who to greet or nap beside; a weight, so a parent it has fallen out with (bond -0.5 or less) still loses.
bond_doc: a bond at or above friend_at is a friendship, at or below rival_at a rivalry.
bond_tag_doc: added to both Boki's bond each time one tags the other in a game of tag.
bond_share_doc: added when two Boki that get on share a toy.
bond_nap_doc: per second two Boki nap side by side.
bond_squabble_doc: added when two Boki squabble over a toy or their tempers clash.
mentor_doc: s between a retired mentor's slow steps near the Soul Shrine (Mentor, GARDEN.md section 3).
mentor_radius_doc: m from the Soul Shrine a mentor strolls.
new_toy_doc: a toy you place (BaseLife.new_toy): roaming Boki within near m on its island come to look for gather s (random in the range, the same for all) and chatter; then the most curious plays at it first.
clash_doc: the summed temper above 1.0 at which two Boki that meet may squabble; higher tempers squabble more.
shy_doc: a Boki adopted from the Shelter is shy for secs of farm time (one farm day, home.gd DAY_LEN; scripts/home/base_shy.gd): it keeps to the island's edge (the farthest from the middle of edge_picks open spots) and takes no part in tag or toys.
notice_doc: a Boki notices you coming back (scripts/home/base_greet.gd): a roaming Boki that had you more than far_m m away for away_s s and sees you within near_m m rolls chance + rank_chance x its bond rank (Care.BONDS index, 0 Wary to 4 Soulbound) + cling_chance x its cling (personality, 0.08 to 0.5). On a hit it looks at you for look_s s; from bond rank run_rank (2, Close) it runs to a spot slot_m m from you (reach_m m of slack), then follows you at its walk for follow_s s, giving up after give_up_s s in all. One roll per return.
trail_doc: your partner trails you in the garden (scripts/home/base_greet.gd, the follow half of the Greet state): while you move it keeps between min_m and max_m m of you (past max_m it walks to settle_m m from you on the line to where it was; closer than min_m while you walk it drops back to settle_m m behind you); it goes at your speed, never under walk_mps or over run_mps; it stops when you stop, sits after sit_s s of you standing, and stands up when you move. Over leash_m m away, or on another island, it leaps to you (home.gd _start_leap). It never goes within pad_m m of the Waystone or return pad (it waits at the ring), and holds still while the hop to another zone lights up. Every check_s s it drops back to Roam so a hungry or tired partner eats or naps first, then trails again.
hand_doc: feeding from your hand (scripts/home/base_hand_feed.gd): slot_m m from you where a Boki stops to eat, arrive_m m of slack on it; a shy Boki (trust under whistle.shy_trust) stops shy_stop_m m away the first time and comes the whole way when asked again within shy_window_s s; give_up_s s of walking before it drops the offer; eat_s s of eating at your hand, done_s s to enjoy it; trust points a hand-fed Boki gains.
whistle_doc: the whistle (scripts/home/base_whistle.gd): hold_s s the key is held before the nearest other Boki is called as well as your partner; a Boki with joy need under sulky_joy or trust under shy_trust only looks over (a droop and a head turn), waits wait_s s and walks over at sulky_pace of the call run; an answering Boki first makes a beat: perk_s s, plus up to turn_s s to turn to face you (so one already facing you loses only perk_s); slot_m m from you where an answering Boki stops; pace is the run speed scale at no eagerness and at full eagerness (trust 60%, condition 40%), on the farm's 4.4 m/s call run; give_up_s s before an answer that has not arrived is dropped; the hint_* keys are the one-time whistle line (scripts/home/whistle_hint.gd): shown once the partner has been over hint_far_m m away, or out of sight, for hint_away_s s; hint_lift_px px above the screen's bottom edge (over the key row); hint_text beside the key cap. happy_at is the eagerness from which a called Boki answers happy, under it unsure.
